name: @podium/live-grants
description: Short-lived signed grants for the live channel (POD-6954 design 4.5): the format, Ed25519 signing by Core and verification by the room and the daemon with a public key ring. A client grant names the sessions, machines, roots and logins a member may watch or use; a daemon grant names its machine. No database and no network in the verifier. Depends only on @podium/model; never apps/*.
